title: Federated learning strategy optimization method and device based on breadth learning

pse.problem: High communication cost, data heterogeneity leading to slow model convergence in federated learning.
pse.solution_function: Optimizes federated learning strategy by reducing communication rounds and using important parameters for model update to improve training speed.
pse.solution_structure: Includes a central parameter server, edge devices with local data, and a method for selecting the largest k values of parameter update in a single model.
pse.solution_implementation: The central parameter server aggregates updates from edge devices using a method that selects the largest k values. This results in model compression and reduces communication cost.
pse.effect: Improved training speed in federated learning due to reduced communication rounds and the use of important parameters for model update.
